outcome: Use the harness on current work, separate diagnostics from delivery evidence, and reduce self-imposed adoption friction.
constraints: No Kernel, base, pack, consumer product or immutable release changes
Keep existing document declarations and entry limits; no new gate or dependency
Historical diagnostics and mechanism smoke do not qualify current delivery
No minimum task quota, fabricated acceptance, credential or network isolation claim

acceptance.description: Operator preflight references the active task and leaves verification and acceptance pending
Self budget, historical metrics, smoke boundaries and shared-writing instructions match the approved repair

tier_waivers.reason: No new pure-function implementation. These repository policy and real adapter CLI checks complement, not replace, existing document/metrics/receipt unit tests and the mandatory whole suite.
